_comment: RF1116 AI_MINED_LLM generator, pinned model and limits (signed fd22876f §3.1/§3.3/§3.5; ★M (a) and ★K (b), Owner 2026-11-17 d4c05dd7; holdout freeze 0fefcd24 model rule; brief 93a93509 + addendum 2 5ab7b720). The model is this config value, not a code constant. A round's manifest records this file's sha256; changing the file after a round opens stops that round's generation (MINE_RUNNER_LLM_CONFIG_CHANGED). Changing the model to a version released after the holdout start needs a new holdout (new set of rounds), decided by the coordinator.
